items.title: Airbnb Floats Price-Matching: A Skift Test Shows Where Direct Booking Wins
items.why: Price matching may narrow the direct-booking edge that hotel partner perks depend on.
items.summary_ai: Airbnb is considering price matching, and a Skift test shows where booking direct still comes out ahead.
items.take: Price matching may narrow the direct-booking edge that hotel partner perks depend on.
